05 · Record once. Disciple all week.

Seven 90-second devotional scripts from every sermon.

Curator creates teleprompter-ready daily scripts designed so the pastor can record the entire week in roughly one short batch session. Each script reinforces Sunday and recruits people into the next step or journey.
